title: Clogheen , Blarney, Co. Cork
description:
Woodlawn Clogheen, Cork, T23 R582

A Rare Dual-Residence Opportunity on the City’s Doorstep

“Two detached homes. One exceptional address.”

“Live in one. Let the other" 

Set within a mature and private site on the highly regarded Old Blarney Road, this exceptional offering comprises two detached residential properties in one strategic acquisition — combining countryside tranquillity with immediate access to the city.

Located just minutes from Cork city centre and within easy reach of Apple European Headquarters, Blarney and Ballincollig, this property delivers a rare blend of privacy, flexibility and investment strength.

The Main Residence
Three-Bedroom Detached Bungalow

Presented in Very Good Condition

A spacious and well-proportioned bungalow extending to part of the total 188 m² (c. 2,000 sq ft) floor area.

Accommodation Highlights:

Three generous bedrooms

Three bathrooms

Master bedroom adapted for wheelchair accessibility

Bright and well-balanced living accommodation

Oil Fired Central Heating

E-Fibre Broadband

Mains Water & Drainage

Designed to accommodate a broad range of lifestyle needs, the property is particularly suited to families, downsizers seeking single-level living, or buyers requiring accessible features.

The Cottage
One-Bedroom Detached Residence

Self-Contained & Versatile

A separate detached cottage in good condition, ideal for:

Rental income

Multi-generational living

Guest accommodation

Independent home office

Long-term investment holding

The flexibility of two detached dwellings on one mature site is increasingly rare in this established location.

Investment & Lifestyle Appeal

This property offers a highly adaptable ownership model:

For Owner-Occupiers

Live in one residence and rent the other

Accommodate extended family privately

Secure long-term capital appreciation in a high-demand location

For Investors

Dual income potential

No current rent cap noted

Strong tenant demand due to proximity to major employment centres

Agent indicates availability of pre-approved tenants

Properties combining location, condition, and structural flexibility at this price point are seldom available in this area.

Location

Clogheen on the Old Blarney Road is a mature and established residential setting offering a peaceful countryside atmosphere while remaining moments from:

City centre amenities

Schools & medical facilities

Retail centres & restaurants

Sporting & recreational facilities

Major employment hubs

This is a prime city-edge position with enduring demand fundamentals.

Key Details

Guide Price: €495,000

Total Floor Area: 188 m² / c. 2,000 sq ft

BER Rating: D1

BER Number: 119049237

Eircode: T23 R582

Sale Method: Private Treaty

Services: OFCH, E-Fibre Broadband, ESB, Mains Water & Drainage

Solicitors

80 South Mall, Cork

Humphrey Hogan & Associates

An Exceptional Dual-Dwelling Acquisition

A compelling combination of privacy, flexibility, and investment security — positioned in one of Cork’s most strategically located residential corridors.
